source_of_truth: bibles/ hold every character fact. This file holds pointers, extraction rules and structured data. Identity blocks carry no outfit sentence; never duplicate block prose.
delimiter_convention: Machine markers look like <!-- PROMPT-BLOCK-START: <id> --> and <!-- PROMPT-BLOCK-END: <id> -->. The compiler extracts marker-to-marker and strips the marker lines themselves.
layout: Each character lives in its own folder with a bible file (PROMPT.md) and any reference images. Paths in this file are relative to the universe root.

shared_blocks.render_grade_animated: Flat painterly animation with bold clean ink outlines and flat colour fills with soft cel shading. Cinematic composition, motivated lighting. 4:5 portrait composition. No text, no lettering, no captions, no logos and no watermark anywhere in the image.

example-hero.proportions: head about one seventh of height; adult proportions
constants: round green glasses in every outfit
blue raincoat is the only saturated colour in the frame
short brown hair, freckles, clean skin

example-hero.raincoat.description: a blue raincoat, grey trousers and white trainers

example-hero.overalls.short: denim overalls over a white shirt
example-hero.overalls.description: denim overalls over a white shirt and brown boots

constants: the costume is one piece, always worn whole
